caption: The drawing shows a black elephant standing upright on its hind legs atop a round, red pedestal with yellow trim near the base and top. The elephant is dressed in a red garment or costume, which is detailed with yellow trim and buttons, and it has a yellow ring around its midsection. The elephant's tusks and the inside of its ear are white, and a yellow hoop is held by the trunk, positioned slightly forward. To the right of the elephant, handwritten text reads: "OTHER SIDE OF BANK SHOWING OPENING AT TOP FOR COINS AND CONNECTION ON FRONT TOP HOOP." The artwork is signed "GRACE HALPIN" below the text. The background is a plain, uncolored, light beige or cream tone.
title: Penny Bank
